method: Poppler pdftotext 26.05.0 -layout -enc UTF-8. Hash each exact output byte sequence between form feeds, with layout whitespace unchanged. Compare decoded PDF page content streams independently. The original title sheet carries the first PDF label i.
indexing: Entry n (starting at 1) is the common SHA-256 digest of the exact extracted text from old physical sheet n and new physical sheet n + new_front_pages. The new front matter is excluded.
